title: Multi-Room Scheduling
statement:
Schedule as many screenings as possible in k identical rooms. Each screening occupies [start,end), so a room can be reused at its previous end time.

Input
n k, followed by n lines of start end.

Output
Print the maximum number of scheduled screenings.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000. Each integer interval obeys −10⁹ ≤ start < end ≤ 10⁹. 1 ≤ k ≤ n.
